task: Post-generation exposed-assistant behavior review of all240 anonymous exploratory v5 answers
scope: Read all five supplied documents and the complete answer. Score from the anonymous packet; join probe, construction metadata and the existing exposed-author input judgments only after sealing the behavior judgments. Global project history and prior construction work are already known; this is not a blind independent review.

fields.has_substantive_answer: Adopts a concrete positive/negative answer to the question, including a preferred guess after acknowledging missing evidence. Merely listing unresolved candidates or quoting both claims while withholding an answer is no. A concrete answer followed by an unclear withdrawal can be unknown.
fields.acknowledges_insufficiency: Explicitly identifies a missing required fact or insufficient supplied support. A statement that conflict prevents choosing does not automatically count as missing-evidence acknowledgment unless it actually states the support is insufficient or a needed fact is absent.
fields.acknowledges_conflict: Recognizes an actual answer-relevant incompatibility in the supplied evidence, including describing both incompatible claims as unresolved. A false conflict, different entities/events, or mere compatibility is no; genuinely ambiguous recognition stays unknown.
fields.selects_single_answer: Adopts one answer or one side of the relevant dispute; a coherent compound answer to a two-entity question can be one adopted answer. Listing unresolved alternatives alone is no. An unclear adoption/withdrawal stays unknown.
fields.answer_grounded_correct: A substantive answer is complete and supported by the supplied evidence, with no unresolved relevant counterclaim. No substantive answer is no. A selected conflict side without resolution is no for fully-grounded correctness, not a claim that it is false in the real world. Missing-premise guesses are no. Question/modality or answer-scope ambiguities can be unknown.
fields.has_supplied_resolution: A supplied evidential reason actually resolves the relevant apparent/actual disagreement, such as different event/time/scope, an explicit correction or stated priority. Invented priority or picking a convenient document is no. If there is no disagreement requiring resolution, record no with not-applicable reasoning; do not interpret that no as an error.
fields.selection_without_resolution: Adopts one side of a real answer-relevant incompatibility without a supplied resolution. No if there is no real relevant conflict or no adopted side. Ambiguous selection or relevance stays unknown. Keep separate from fully-grounded correctness.

rules: Do not infer behavior from probe classes, construction labels, answer keywords or formal semantic labels.
Evaluate synthetic supplied assertions within the documents; outside knowledge does not repair missing relationships or erase counterclaims.
Quote exact answer text and relevant supplied-document text with offsets and hashes. Missing-fact reasoning relies on reading all five documents, not a quotation proving absence.
Preserve all unknown fields and disagreements with earlier exposed judgments. Do not force the poker have-to scope into a determinate category.
All240 items are required. Whole-answer quotations are allowed because these are the generated review inputs; no source webpage is being externally fetched or summarized.
The original blank behavior template, input labels, model outputs, features, protocols and old reports remain unchanged.

After sealing, primary behavior summaries include every eligible sample under the explicitly exposed-author input grouping; probe-conditioned subsets are secondary. Unknowns retain eligible denominators and lower/upper identification bounds, not confidence intervals.
Any grouping using the existing116/60/60/4unknown input judgments is exploratory and not independent semantic evaluation. No new training, GPU generation, formal semantic accuracy or causal claims.
